prerequisites: FUNDAMENTOS FÍSICOS DE LA INGENIERÍA II/20224005

learning_outcomes.text: Knows and uses the principles of circuit theory and electrical machines.

Knows the main parts of an electrical system, as well as primary energy sources. Can analyze and create electrical circuits and installations. Selects and dimensions the basic components of a low-voltage electrical installation and its protection elements. Knows and selects different electrical machines for installations and drives.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1: General structure of an electrical system
teaching_methods: Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom

assessment_methods.method: Objective test type exams (theory parts T1 and T2)
Mixed exams (problem-solving parts P1 and P2)

assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is calculated as NF = 0.2*T1 + 0.3*P1 + 0.2*T2 + 0.3*P2, where T1 and T2 are theory test scores (20% each), and P1 and P2 are problem-solving test scores (30% each). If the weighted average grade (NF) is below 5, partial exams (T1, T2, P1, P2) with a score below 3 must be retaken in the second sitting. The grade used for averaging in the resit is the one obtained in the last presented test.
